stem: Which sentence from the selection suggests that companies may want to reconsider their approach to branding their products?

options.label: F
options.text: We see them on signs, vehicles, television, and even on the clothes we wear. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: Researchers have developed a theory they think might help to explain this blind spot in our memories. (paragraph 3)

options.label: H
options.text: The details of product logos are just the kind of information our brains tell us we do not need. (paragraph 5)

options.label: J
options.text: But there are still many business experts who believe in the importance of a recognizable logo. (paragraph 5)
